name: GIN-Wallpaper-Calend
description: Smart Desktop Wallpaper with Calendar for Windows 10/11 (Clean top bar with horizontal dashes, RU/EN/CS order, compact sound button, wider 2nd font column for zero text clipping, Cars & Supercars kept, Trucks & Off-Road and aesthetic Girls: Models & Fashion categories)
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev
features: Clean top bar layout: Day/Night buttons separated from languages by dash, RU/EN/CS language order, and separated from sound button by dash with ~1mm spacing
Compact sound toggle button (reduced from 180px to 140px width)
Reduced gap between font columns by ~5 mm and expanded Column 2 width to 420px so Century Gothic Bold and long date samples never truncate
Kept 'Cars & Supercars' category, added 'Trucks & 4x4 Off-Road' and non-vulgar aesthetic 'Girls: Models & Fashion' (purity=100 SFW)
Full trilingual EN/CS/RU localization, minimal installer, silent uninstaller, and ~1.5-2 MB idle RAM consumption
